purpose: Frozen held-out H12 confirmation of the validation-passed MambaTSv3 prediction-connected AutoCon fusion candidate on METR-LA and PEMS-BAY.
research_question: Does the frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon representation-fusion candidate remain non-inferior to registered baselines on two traffic-speed benchmarks under a held-out streaming protocol?
evidence_boundary: Selection is validation-only. Test metrics are read only after every confirmation phase validator succeeds and cannot select any model or hyperparameter.
claim_boundary: This release is restricted to METR-LA/PEMS-BAY H12. It does not establish universal forecasting, graph-aware, long-horizon, causal AutoCon, or hardware-independent speed claims.

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The candidate architecture and AutoCon lambda are frozen from the completed fusion validation and same-source baseline confirmation.

confirmation_contract.test_read_gate: Read test metrics only after every registered phase validator succeeds.
confirmation_contract.independence_note: Seed-level paired contrasts are the uncertainty unit; forecast windows and channels are not inferential replicates.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share data loader, chronological split, features, sequence length, horizon, epochs, patience, optimizer, scheduler, batch, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.external_baseline_boundary: External baselines are same-source references; capacity and latency are reported separately.

accuracy_claim_contract.boundary: Primary claim is restricted to registered non-inferiority comparators.

phases.name: selection_fusion_candidate_validation
phases.purpose: Validation-only executable contract check for the frozen fusion candidate.

phases.name: confirmatory_fusion_candidate_test
phases.purpose: Frozen fusion candidate held-out test phase.

phases.name: confirmatory_same_source_baselines_test
phases.purpose: Frozen same-source external baselines under the identical held-out contract.

statistical_gate.interpretation: A cell is non-inferior only when its one-sided paired upper ratio bound is <=1.02.
statistical_gate.small_n_warning: Five seeds remain modest and do not support universal claims.

resource_contract.efficiency_claim_gate: Report only named-comparator speed results whose accuracy gate passes.

prelaunch_gates: verify data hashes and exact 76-job expansion
keep test metrics out of selection
run all phases under immutable launch sidecar
read test metrics only after all strict validators pass
